dedupe_keys.name: indomet dominican republic climatological data and station statistics

description: The Dominican Institute of Meteorology (INDOMET) publishes climatological products and open data. Its climatology section offers statistics of weather phenomena observed at the stations of the national meteorological network, broken down by station and consolidated by month, counting mist, fog, dust haze, dew, storms, thunder, lightning, strong winds, hail and other phenomena (for example an XLSX file for January and February 2026), together with bulletins on meteorological drought, climate watch, climate change and ENSO, a seasonal climate forecast and statistical analyses of weather phenomena. On the national open data portal INDOMET lists four datasets: maximum and minimum temperature and relative humidity at the SATRD Jarabacoa station for 2026, monthly rainfall totals for 2018 to 2026, maximum, minimum and mean temperatures at the Santo Domingo central station for 2023 to 2026, and the number of weather products issued from 2018 to 2026. The site also links automatic stations, radar, buoys and tsunami information. Access is free online; no licence is stated on the institute's page read. Caveats: the open datasets cover few stations, and the pages are in Spanish. Coverage is the Dominican Republic. It supports hazard exposure and climate adaptation analysis of heavy rain, storms, heat and drought for roads, power and water systems; related records are the IMN Costa Rica climate atlas and stations and the Cyprus Department of Meteorology climatology.
